title: QQ 飞车
assessmentType: Review of existing published gameplay images, original documentation and prior runtime evidence; no new gameplay execution in this comparison
confidence: medium; archived gameplay evidence, not a newly executed review
visualFindings: 城市道路、护栏、看台和天际线密度较高，车身/车灯/氮气UI可分辨。
低多边形车辆和树木较简单；较多品牌标识与中文HUD，视觉统一性尚可。
gameplayFindings: 已归档正常比赛画面及Android真实SDK报告；前轮已用正常输入完成一圈，非本轮重试玩。
四条赛道、竞速/道具模式、漂移/氮气/小喷；无大型生涯系统。
packagingNotes: 已有Android与Mac；本次候选若入选仍须Windows与当前源码三平台一致性验收。
原目录准确保留ISC声明与缺少根LICENSE的事实，第三方品牌素材不由包内工具许可覆盖。
limitations: No physical television/controller test in this review.
Motion presentation is judged from visible feedback plus archived gameplay documentation, not this machine GPU FPS.
The comparison does not claim a new complete-race test.
